name: Fan-In 30K
comments: Reduced-rate variant of Fan-In-50K-500-50K-50K.json, for hosts that cannot sustain
50k msg/s. 30k publishers, 30k publish topics, 500 subscribers on one shared
subscription, 1 msg/s per publisher, so 30k/s in aggregate.
publish_rate is an integer msg/s per publisher, so a lower aggregate rate is reached by
reducing the publisher count rather than the per-publisher rate. That also reduces the
topic count to 30k, since topics are one per publisher.
Shared subscription filter and topic shape follow the Open MQTT Benchmark Suite's
sharesub case (see the 50K scenario for the reference and the MQTT3 rationale).
Connections are paced at 5000/s. Without it the client opens all of them as fast as it
can - 20000 CONNECTs in half a second, some 37000/s, a rate no deployment produces and
none of these scenarios ever claimed to measure. The connect phase is setup here, not the
measurement, which starts when publishing does.
